author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Lando Norris secured pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix on Saturday with a late lap at Madrid’s new Madring circuit. The McLaren driver recorded 1 minute, 31.824 seconds and beat Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli by 0.011 seconds.

Norris sat sixth before his final attempt but found enough speed despite acknowledging a small error at the last corner. The result delivered the 19th pole of his Formula One career and his third of the 2026 season. Max Verstappen qualified third for Red Bull, while Lewis Hamilton placed fourth.

Starting position could carry extra weight at a circuit where drivers and teams expect overtaking to be difficult. The narrow qualifying margin also leaves little separation among the leading cars before Sunday’s race. Madring is hosting Formula One for the first time, adding an unfamiliar layout to the normal challenge of managing tires, strategy and traffic. Norris now has the best starting spot, but Antonelli and Verstappen will begin close enough to apply immediate pressure.
dek: The McLaren driver edged Kimi Antonelli by 0.011 seconds with a late qualifying lap at Formula One’s new Madrid circuit.
headline: Lando Norris takes Spanish Grand Prix pole at Madring
